# BestRestaurantDenver.com

> An independent guide to eating in the city of Denver, Colorado. The directory is the 2026 MICHELIN
> Guide Colorado selection for Denver (37 restaurants), reorganised to be searchable. A separate,
> sourced list covers James Beard-recognized kitchens, bars and city institutions the guide does not
> list. We do not rank restaurants by opinion and we do not sell placement.
> Published by Search Converts LLC. Edited by Zach Wennstedt, Denver, Colorado.

## Open data

- [restaurants.json](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/data/restaurants.json): 51 Denver restaurants and bars with address, neighborhood, cuisine, award, source URLs and a "verified" date for each record. Free to quote with attribution and a link.

## Editorial policy

- The main directory contains only restaurants in the current MICHELIN Guide Colorado selection.
- The beyond-MICHELIN list requires at least two independent published sources per entry.
- No payment, affiliate link or placement fee affects any list on this site.
- We do not publish hours, prices, ratings or reviews. No aggregateRating or Review markup.
- Meal-picker occasion tags are our own rule-based labels, defined on /editorial-policy/.
- Advertising is served by Google and kept separate from every list.

## Pages

- [Best Restaurants in Denver](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/): searchable directory of all 37 Denver restaurants in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Colorado, with addresses, neighborhoods, cuisines and award tiers.
- [Denver meal picker](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/denver-meal-picker/): choose craving, occasion and area; returns five sourced matches and a nearby drinks stop.
- [Denver beyond MICHELIN](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/denver-restaurants-beyond-michelin/): Yuan Wonton, El Taco de Mexico, Sắp Sửa and other James Beard-recognized or historic Denver restaurants, with sources.
- [What changed in Denver's 2026 MICHELIN Guide](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/michelin-guide-denver-2026/)
- [Denver restaurants by neighborhood](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/denver-restaurants-by-neighborhood/)
- [RiNo and Five Points](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/rino-five-points-restaurants/), [LoHi and the Highlands](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/highlands-restaurants-denver/), [South Pearl, Wash Park and Cherry Creek](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/south-pearl-wash-park-cherry-creek-restaurants/)
- [Mexican](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/mexican-restaurants-denver/), [Chinese, Japanese and Taiwanese](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/asian-restaurants-denver/), [Italian](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/italian-restaurants-denver/), [Tasting menus](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/tasting-menus-denver/)
- [Best brunch in Denver](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/best-brunch-in-denver/): ordered by how many independent outlets recommend each spot.
- [What to eat in Denver](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/what-to-eat-in-denver/): green chile, Colorado produce and a harvest calendar.
- [Denver restaurant reservations](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/denver-restaurant-reservations/)
- [Editorial policy](https://bestrestaurantdenver.com/editorial-policy/)

## Sources

- MICHELIN Guide Colorado 2026 selection (announced 14 September 2026), via MICHELIN, Visit Denver and KDVR.
- James Beard Foundation award lists 2020 to 2026, as reported by Westword, 5280, Denverite, DiningOut and others.
- 5280 magazine, Westword and Time Out Denver for brunch recommendations.

## Statewide
